name: mbnsfr-ai-coding-assistant
description: Private VS Code multi-agent coordinator: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, Microsoft Copilot browser handoff, free API/local model routing, downgrade detection, isolated worktrees.

commands.title: mbnsfr AI: Configure API or Local Models
mbnsfr AI: Pin a Subscription CLI Model
mbnsfr AI: Run Optimized Read-Only Plan + Review
mbnsfr AI: Implement in a Safe Separate Git Worktree
mbnsfr AI: Copy Handoff for Microsoft Copilot
mbnsfr AI: Add Repository Agent Instructions

mbAI.routes.plan.description: Sequential routing order for read-only planning tasks.

mbAI.routes.implement.description: Implementation agents. Only supported subscription CLIs may modify code; a fresh Git worktree is mandatory.

mbAI.routes.review.description: Sequential routing order for independent read-only review.

mbAI.maxAttempts.description: Maximum distinct providers tried per stage.

mbAI.allowPaidOrUnverifiedApis.description: EXPLICIT OPT-IN: permits paid/unverified API calls (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Cloudflare, NVIDIA, Cerebras, DeepSeek, custom). These can incur usage charges; free tier is account/model specific.

mbAI.requireModelEvidence.description: If enabled, fail over when a pinned model has no machine-readable confirmation of actual model identity. May block providers that do not report model IDs.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check lib/core.js && node --check lib/adapters.js
